releases.notes:
Fixed a crash when you go back to your active workout.
Fixed a freeze when you edit a set after you reopen the app.
Faster app start, also on a slow network.
Failed workout saves now retry automatically.
Apple Health sync is more reliable.
Imported workouts show better titles, and rides show your speed.
Fixed sets that were marked as done together by mistake.
Better weight suggestions for weighted bodyweight exercises.
Other small fixes and improvements.

• Workout Focus: Block distracting apps while you train, with optional access during rest breaks.
• Rebuilt Apple Watch experience: Better synchronization with your iPhone, more reliable rest timers, and a simplified view for logging sets.
• Creator training plans: Train with Hermes and Sandra through structured plans with progressive phases, workout previews, and exercise videos.
• Personalized plan recommendations: Get help choosing a training plan based on your schedule, goals, and available equipment.
• Redesigned Library: Find workouts, plans, and exercises faster with improved search, filters, and sorting that remembers your preferences.
• New themes: Personalize Gravl with Stealth, Pulse, and Rose, alongside Light and Original.
• Clearer progress tracking: Refreshed body measurements, exercise analytics, and progress screens.
• Fixes and improvements: Better workout saving, pause and resume behavior, exercise replacements, and duplicate handling in Apple Health.

Upcoming workouts now stay in the correct order after you reorganize your week or complete workouts out of sequence.
Injury-aware workouts now clearly explain when exercises have been adjusted or when it’s better to skip a workout.
Support conversations now show when a reported issue has been resolved.
We’ve also polished gym profiles and fixed several smaller issues.

- New: Injuries - adapt your workouts based on training limitations.
- New: Monthly Review Stories.
- New: Feature Requests section in Profile.
- Plate calculator improvements.
- Fixed a bug when reordering workouts.
- Fixed streak badges not unlocking.
- Fixed Apple Music pausing on rest timer sound.

Tap any target weight and Gravl tells you why it picked it, based on
your estimated 1RM and how the lift has gone recently.

Progression is smarter: miss a set and you keep the reps you proved,
weight jumps stay close to what you've actually lifted, and machines
with big weight steps finally work properly.

Records and 1RMs are now per gym, so a stronger machine somewhere else
doesn't hide your progress here.

New plate inventory. Tell Gravl what plates your gym has and the
calculator sticks to them, and warns you when a weight won't load.

Support is in the app now. Ask the assistant, attach a photo, or talk to
a real person.

Garmin: four more watches supported, and a watch app install that
actually works.

Plus redesigned form analysis, workout celebrations, measurement trends,
faster syncing and a long list of fixes.
features: Explains why each target weight was picked

releases.notes: Fixed an issue where replacing an exercise could make it disappear from the workout list.

- New workout share editor with templates, stickers, photo effects, fonts, color controls, and Instagram sharing improvements.
- Added progress photo support for body metrics, including capture, upload, gallery, and before/after comparison.
- Added workout AI summaries for completed workouts.
- Updated dark/light theme
- Improved Strength Score with exercise score targets, score badges during workouts, level celebrations, friend score badges, stale-score recommendations, and new excluded-muscle settings.
- Added smarter exercise recommendations that prioritize muscles and exercises needing updated score data.
- Added streak improvements, including streak rewards, freeze syncing, timeframe sheets, celebration screens, and refreshed streak/progress UI.
- Added first-day-of-week setting and updated streaks, trends, measurements, calendars, and activity views to respect it.
- Improved onboarding, coachmarks, quick workout walkthroughs, and deep-link recovery for web/onboarding flows.
- Refreshed the Library, Progress, Profile, Settings, exercise analytics, workout summary, and friend activity screens.
- Improved Apple Health workout sync, including background sync for external workouts.
- Fixed workout dates shifting across time zones in feed, calendar, weekly summaries, and exercise history.
- Fixed rest timer behavior in the background and short rest times in workout summaries.
- Fixed workout logging responsiveness, keyboard spacing, focused input color, and exercise note editing.
- Fixed workout start/back-stack issues, active workout cancel state, pending save visibility, and watch sync updates.

- New onboarding flow with improved Apple Health permissions, body stats, gym selection, and personalized workout plan summary
- Find your gym during setup so Gravl can preload available equipment when supported
- Improved Apple Health workout import with route previews, heart rate, distance, and workout metrics when available
- Workout details now show richer cardio metrics and route maps for supported workouts
- Community and friend flows have been upgraded with profile completion, username search, QR invites, and friend request actions
- Apple Watch workout syncing is more reliable, with better finished-workout handling and personal record feedback
- New activity widget support and refreshed app/watch icons
- General polish across onboarding, translations, notifications, profile setup, and app stability
